newsitem.title: FINLAND: VAAHTO JUMPS AS 12-MONTH PROFIT DOUBLES.
newsitem.headline: VAAHTO JUMPS AS 12-MONTH PROFIT DOUBLES.

text.p: Shares in Finnish process industry equipment maker Vaahto Oy surged on Wednesday following a sharp rise in the group's 12-month profit, brokers said.
At 1105/0805 GMT, Vaahto traded at 95.00 markka, up 10 markka or almost 12 percent. Turnover was active for Vaahto at 1.5 million markka.

"Vaahto's result was very much above expectations, besides the share is still relatively cheap," one broker said, referring to a sharp fall in the stock in January, when Vaahto dropped from a 145.00 life-high to levels around 80.00 markka.
Another broker said he had been targeting a price over 100.00 markka for Vaahto, but planned to revise that upwards now.
Vaahto said its pre-tax profit in the fiscal year to end February rose to a "record" 32.9 million markka from 14.7 million the previous year.
